
## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `scoresight-*-windows-x64-setup.exe` | Windows 10 (1809) or newer, 64-bit: installer |
| `scoresight-*-windows-x64-portable.zip` | Windows 10 (1809) or newer, 64-bit: unzip and run `scoresight.exe` |
| `scoresight-*-macos-arm64.dmg` | macOS 15 or newer, Apple Silicon |
| `scoresight-*-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Linux x86_64 with glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+): extract and run `scoresight/scoresight` |

Intel Macs: [0.4.4](https://github.com/royshil/scoresight/releases/tag/0.4.4) is the last release with an Intel Mac build.

Verify a download with `SHA256SUMS.txt`, for example `sha256sum --check --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS.txt`
(macOS: `shasum -a 256 --check --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS.txt`; Windows PowerShell: compare
`Get-FileHash <file>` with the file's line in `SHA256SUMS.txt`).

## Questions, ideas, feedback

We'd love to hear how you use ScoreSight. Come say hi in [**ScoreSight's Discussions**](https://github.com/royshil/scoresight/discussions):

- **Ask a question** in [Q&A](https://github.com/royshil/scoresight/discussions/categories/q-a)
- **Suggest a feature** in [Ideas](https://github.com/royshil/scoresight/discussions/categories/ideas)
- **Show your setup** (your sport, scoreboard and production) in [Show and tell](https://github.com/royshil/scoresight/discussions/categories/show-and-tell)
- **Found a bug?** [Report it](https://github.com/royshil/scoresight/issues/new/choose) and attach your logs
